messages:
luke-cs: FYI acmecorp reporting repeated 503s from Dedicated pool3 during peak, they say it started ~22:30 UTC. SLA at risk, customer wants ETA and workaround. Logs show OOM-ish traces. pinging @maria-eng @ajay-platform.

luke-cs: logs (snip):
```
2026-03-17T22:31:02Z serve: pool3 worker killed: OOM
2026-03-17T22:31:02Z kernel: failed allocate kv_cache[512MB]
2026-03-17T22:31:05Z upstream: 503 requesting model redwood/quant-v3-2026b
```

maria-eng: On it — initial read looks like memory pressure in the runtime + a model variant with different KV usage. @taylor-ml did we push the quant change to any prod shards?

taylor-ml: We rolled the quant-v3 change to canary yesterday, but the model variant redwood/quant-v3-2026b was promoted to a subset of prod yesterday morning by the release job. There is an open PR that increases layer kv footprint (PR #789).

ajay-platform: Let's assign clear owners: maria -> runtime patch (eviction/alloc guard), taylor -> model revert if needed, ajay -> release & routing (temp pin). Proposed timeline: 90m total: 40m for patch/review, 20m canary, 30m rollout. Canary window earliest 23:05 UTC. Does that work for oncall?

luke-cs: Customer wants earliest window, canary is fine. They need a fallback plan if canary fails. Also want an explicit ETA to share with them.

maria-eng: I'll open the runtime PR now. If we can't land runtime patch quickly, fallback is to route acmecorp to older model variant manually. That requires a temp routing override from ajay.

ajay-platform: I can add a temp routing rule. Need exact model id to pin them to. Also will coordinate the canary and monitor the pool. I'll set up the canary at 23:05 and watch p99/p50 and OOM traces.

oncall-bot: @channel On-call PD notified for pool3 surge: https://pd.example/incidents/4248001234 — acknowleged?

taylor-ml: Model id to pin: redwood/quant-v3-2026a (previous stable). Revert PR: https://git.example/redwood/models/pulls/789 — I can cut a revert release in ~40m if needed.

maria-eng: PR opened: https://git.example/redwood/serving/pulls/1024 — small change (kv-cache eviction tunable). Unit tests passing locally, CI queued. Requesting 2 reviewers: @ajay-platform and @taylor-ml. Diff snippet: `kv_eviction_threshold = 0.8 -> 0.65`

ajay-platform: Reviewing now. If CI green, I'll merge and schedule canary start at 23:05 UTC (per proposed). Routing rule prepared; will hold until we confirm merge.

sana-prod: If we push a rollback or customer pin, product wants to be looped re: credits/communication. Loop me if we need to offer any SLA remediation.

luke-cs: Noted, I'll keep Sana in the loop. Telling customer ETA ~1.5h (subject to merge). Will update after merge.

maria-eng: Merge done at 4248001300 — runtime patch merged. Starting canary now, will monitor logs/metrics. If errors spike, we'll revert and pin acmecorp to redwood/quant-v3-2026a immediately. Dashboard: https://dash.example/boards/pool3-monitor

ajay-platform: Canary running 23:05–23:25 UTC. Routing override ready: acmecorp -> redwood/quant-v3-2026a if needed, will flip in 2m.

luke-cs: Thanks all — I'll update customer: runtime patch merged, canary active, rollback/pin ready. Will re-open thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
